question: Among customers who made purchases at gas stations in the Czech Republic, identify the one with the highest total consumption in 2013. For this customer, compute the year-over-year consumption decrease rate from 2012 to 2013, and return their segment and currency.

prediction.sql:
WITH cz_gas_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.XCL_015 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE g.XCL_006 = 'CZE'
),
consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.XCL_001,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS total_2013
    FROM cz_gas_customers AS c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
    GROUP BY c.XCL_001
)
SELECT
    c.XCL_002 AS segment,
    c.XCL_003 AS currency,
    CAST((cm.total_2012 - cm.total_2013) AS REAL) / cm.total_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM consumption AS cm
INNER JOIN customers AS c ON cm.XCL_001 = c.XCL_001
ORDER BY cm.total_2013 DESC
LIMIT 1
